item.title: Seattle high-rises connected by decommissioned Boeing 747 fuselage
item.description: It's been called a tribute to Seattle's innovation in aviation, as a Boeing jet now connects two towers as part of the development underway in the South Lake Union neighborhood.

item.title: Seattle Kraken acquire majority stake in Climate Pledge Arena, launch One Roof Sports &amp; Entertainment
item.description: The ownership of the Seattle Kraken announced the creation of One Roof Sports and Entertainment on Monday, an umbrella corporation that will oversee the group's current sports portfolio with an eye toward a possible bid for an NBA expansion franchise.

item.title: WA man booked into jail for 98th time after high-speed chase in Olympia
item.description: Thurston County deputies arrested a pair of organized retail theft suspects following a high-speed pursuit on I-5 in Olympia.

item.title: Covington community honors fallen Air Force captain
item.description: The Covington community came together Monday night to remember Air Force Captain Ariana Savino, one of six service members killed in a plane crash in Iraq.

item.title: Seattle weather: Wet start to Tuesday with breezy winds
item.description: A wet start to the day Tuesday with widespread showers and snow in the higher elevations.

item.title: What is the King County sheriff's ICE response plan? What we know
item.description: The King County Sheriff’s Office is laying out how deputies will respond when federal immigration agents show up — namely, documentation and de-escalation.

item.title: Gas Works Park ordered to remove ladders, catwalks from historic towers
item.description: Seattle Parks and Rec is ordered to remove all ladders, catwalks and stairways at the Gas Works Park towers by May 15.

item.title: Seattle weather: Stormy stretch, then a ‘spring break’ from the rain
item.description: A winter-like storm will impact Western Washington on Tuesday, bringing rain, wind, and mountain snow.

item.title: Snohomish County stabbing suspect said he was 'sent by Jesus'
item.description: New court documents paint a frightening picture as a man accused of stabbing two people in an Everett, Washington townhome forced his way inside.

item.title: Former Pierce County major sentenced 3 months for DUI crash
item.description: A former Pierce County Sheriff's major was sentenced to three months in jail and community service for crashing into family's SUV while driving under the influence back in July 2025.

item.title: Wallingford businesses targeted in string of brazen break-ins
item.description: A string of brazen break-ins recently targeted small businesses in Seattle’s Wallingford neighborhood, leaving owners feeling vulnerable.

item.title: Pierce County driver wanted after crash sends 32-year-old to ICU
item.description: A 32-year-old man is fighting for his life in the intensive care unit after being struck by two vehicles while returning home from a Seattle Mariners game on Friday night.

item.title: Xander Bogaerts, Mason Miller lead Padres to 4-1 win over Seattle Mariners
item.description: Xander Bogaerts had three hits and three RBIs, and Mason Miller pitched a perfect ninth inning for the San Diego Padres, who beat the Seattle Mariners 4-1 on Tuesday night for their sixth straight win and ninth in 10 games.

item.title: Stevens Pass snowfall could reach up to a foot Tuesday into Wednesday
item.description: Washington transportation officials urged drivers to use caution when traveling through the mountain passes due to heavy snowfall.

item.title: Man stabbed twice in Seattle, hospitalized in serious condition
item.description: A stabbing near the Mount Baker light rail station left a man hospitalized in serious condition, and no arrests have been made.
